roles.title: Builder: Backend engineering
roles.summary: Designing payment orchestration microservices and C2C platform features. Java + Spring Boot + heavy event-driven architecture, with payment gateways and seller/buyer workflows that need to stay reliable at scale.

shipped.title: Payment orchestration system
shipped.body: multi-gateway routing (Razorpay, Juspay, Paytm) handling 1000+ transactions/day at 98% reliability.

shipped.title: C2C workflows
shipped.body: seller/buyer monetization, chat payments, lead generation, seller journeys. Supports 100+ users/min and 50+ daily payments.

shipped.title: Verify-360
shipped.body: a vehicle document verification platform. Users and officials upload, review, approve, and reject documents end-to-end.

shipped.title: Bulk operations + analytics
shipped.body: extended backend APIs for bulk upload/download and analytics dashboards. Improved sales conversion by 50%.

roles.lesson: Payments taught me that 'eventually consistent' is a luxury you don't always get. Some systems demand correctness now, every time.

roles.title: Software Engineer (Automation)
roles.summary: Worked on test automation for Sprinklr's Workforce Management module. Built a modern API automation framework that cut test-case creation time by 70% via dynamic JSON parsing. Optimized Jenkins jobs to drop sanity testing duration by 4 hours.
roles.lesson: Building test infrastructure is engineering, not 'just QA'. Bad tests kill velocity faster than bad code.

roles.title: Builder: Backend engineering
roles.summary: My first full-time engineering role. Led development of 5 HRMS modules (payroll, onboarding, expense management, etc.) with a small team. Cost savings of $50k/year for the company. Built tools used by 900+ employees.
roles.lesson: First job is where you stop coding to learn and start coding to ship. Different skill.

roles.title: SDE Intern
roles.summary: My first taste of production engineering. Integrated Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics, Redux, and Firebase. Set up staging environments on AWS and Firebase, automated deployment via GitLab — cut deploy time by 70%.
roles.lesson: Watching real users break my code taught me more in 5 months than two years of college.

roles.title: B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering
roles.summary: Studied Mechanical Engineering on paper, but spent more nights debugging code than CADding gearboxes. Department Rank 3 (CGPA 8.33). Designed the braking system for the BAJA SAE'21 ATV. Led a 35-person logistics team for Varchas '22.
roles.lesson: The most useful course I 'took' at IIT was the one I didn't enroll in — late nights, Stack Overflow, and the discovery that I liked computers more than gearboxes.
